description: Create a voter guide document comparing three city council candidates on local issues. Read the candidate information from /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/candidate_info.txt and create a well-formatted comparison document with a table showing each candidate's positions. The document should include a title, a comparison table with at least 4 columns (Issue and three candidates) and 4 content rows (covering housing, parks, traffic, and budget issues), and a footer note about the election. Save as voter_guide.docx.
